newsitem.title: FRANCE: CCF interested by part of CIC network.
newsitem.headline: CCF interested by part of CIC network.

text.p: Credit Commercial de France said it was not interested in acquiring the entire banking network of privatisation candidate CIC but might directly invest in some of its local banks.
"CCF will not bid for the entire CIC group," chairman Charles de Croisset told a shareholders' meeting in Nice.
"The value of CIC lies in its local sites. CCF would like to directly invest in some of them," he said.
The comments were included in a CCF statement published on Tuesday.
In November France scrapped a tender for the privatisation of CIC, a unit of French insurer GAN.
De Croisset also said that CCF was interested in Banque Hervet, whose privatisation was put on hold in 1994.
"Banque Hervet offers an interesting opportunity for CCF, but nothing has been decided and it all depends on the state," he said.
